name: Azure Bloom Bowl Set
description: Hand-finished ceramic bowls with soft floral motif—serve desserts or style an open shelf.

name: Opal Artistry Glass Vessel
description: Curved art glass in smoke and amber—made to sit alone on a mantel and steal every glance.

name: The Arlo Woven Vessel
description: Elevate your everyday essentials with the Arlo. Handcrafted with a tight, tactile weave, this versatile basket bridges the gap between functional storage and sculptural art. Whether it’s holding a lush fiddle-leaf fig or keeping your favorite linens within reach, its warm honey tones bring an effortless, grounded feel to any corner of your home.

name: The Echo Woven Set
description: Double the texture, double the style. The Echo Set features two nesting-ready silhouettes handcrafted with a signature diagonal weave. Designed to bring visual height and organic warmth to any room, these vessels work in harmony to hide clutter or showcase your favorite indoor greenery. A perfect blend of architectural form and natural fibers.

name: The Flora Woven Nesting Set
description: Transform your indoor garden with the Flora Set. Specifically designed to elevate your favorite botanicals, these hand-woven vessels feature a deep, sturdy silhouette that perfectly accommodates large planters and decorative stone toppings. The intricate, honey-toned weave provides a stunning natural contrast to vibrant pink bougainvillea or lush green foliage. Sold as a pair, they offer a cohesive, tiered look for sunlit corners and entryways.

name: The Eden Tiered Planter Set
description: Give your indoor garden the pedestal it deserves with the Eden Set. These hand-woven vessels are meticulously crafted to serve as the perfect organic mantle for your favorite botanicals. The deep, cylindrical form is structurally reinforced to support large pots and decorative top-stones, while the warm, honey-toned fibers provide a stunning natural contrast to vibrant pink blooms or lush green fronds. Sold as a nesting pair, they allow you to create dynamic, tiered heights in any sun-drenched corner.

name: The Oasis Triple-Threat Planter Set
description: Why settle for one when you can create a sanctuary? The Oasis Set features three graduated sizes designed to bring professional-tier styling to your home. Hand-woven with a dense, artisanal weave, these vessels are the ultimate home for your botanical collection. From tall, sweeping palms to compact succulents, the neutral honey tones and consistent texture provide a seamless, high-end look that lets your greenery truly pop.

name: Solstice Coastal Nesting Baskets
description: Bring the breezy, effortless luxury of a Mediterranean retreat into your home with the Solstice Set. Crafted from premium, eco-friendly natural fibers, these nesting vessels offer a cohesive aesthetic for the conscious home. Use them together to frame an entryway or distribute them throughout your space to unify your decor. Durable and timeless, they are the perfect way to hide unsightly plastic nursery pots and replace them with rich, tactile craftsmanship.

name: The Elements Collection: Concrete & Fiber Planters
description: Why choose one texture when you can have the best of both worlds? The Elements Collection pairs the raw, industrial soul of weathered concrete with the organic warmth of hand-woven fibers. This curated range is designed for the modern home that thrives on contrast. Use the heavy-set concrete basins for architectural olive trees and the towering woven pillars for lush tropical palms. Together, they create a grounded, multi-dimensional look that feels collected over time.

name: Sierra Heights Faux Yucca Palm
description: Bring Nature Indoors—Without the Upkeep. Elevate your living space with the striking silhouette of our Triple-Trunk Yucca Tree. Designed to mimic the rugged beauty of the high desert, this high-quality artificial plant features three textured, realistic trunks topped with lush, sword-like foliage.

name: Island Breeze Faux Areca Palm
description: Transform any corner into a coastal retreat. Our Island Breeze Palm features delicate, feathery fronds that fan out to create a sense of movement and light. It’s the perfect way to add a soft, organic touch to modern or coastal interiors.

name: Artisan Burgundy Rubber Tree
description: A Sculptural Masterpiece for the Modern Home. With its unique, branching structure and deep-toned leaves, our Artificial Rubber Tree is more than just a plant—it’s a piece of art. Its minimalist profile is designed to complement mid-century modern, dark academia, or industrial interiors.

name: Lush Horizon Faux Palm Tree
description: Bring the Outdoors In—Stress-Free. Create an instant sanctuary with our Majesty Palm. Featuring delicate, arching fronds that catch the light, this life-like botanical adds a soft, organic feel to any room without the need for sunlight or watering.

name: The "Midnight Emerald" Rubber Tree
description: Make a bold statement with the Midnight Emerald. Known for its deep, glossy burgundy-to-green leaves and architectural form, this Ficus Elastica is the ultimate "it-plant" for modern interiors. Low-maintenance but high-impact, it thrives in bright, indirect light and adds a sophisticated vertical element to any room.

name: The "Nordic Willow" Ficus
description: Effortlessly elegant and perfectly balanced. The Nordic Willow is curated for those who love clean lines and natural textures. Its canopy of lush, pointed leaves sits atop a clean, straight trunk, creating a sophisticated "topiary" look that pairs perfectly with white shelving and light wood accents.

name: The "Isla" Majesty Palm
description: Transform your home into a sun-drenched sanctuary. The Isla Palm features sweeping, feathery fronds that create a lush, fountain-like silhouette. Its vibrant green texture provides a stunning organic contrast to modern furniture, bringing a refreshing tropical energy to your lounge or bedroom.

name: The Zenith Sansevieria (Snake Plant)
description: Bold, architectural, and effortlessly cool. The Zenith Snake Plant features rigid, sword-like leaves with striking variegated gold edges that grow straight toward the ceiling. Not only is it a visual powerhouse for modern decor, but it is also one of the hardiest plants for low-light environments.

name: The Juno Strelitzia
description: Make a grand statement with the Juno Strelitzia. Celebrated for its oversized, paddle-shaped leaves and dramatic architectural presence, this plant brings an instant "luxury resort" feel to your home. Its glossy, deep green foliage captures the light beautifully, making it a stunning centerpiece for bright living rooms or sunlit entryways

name: Aura Elevated Ficus Standard
description: Achieve a high-end, gallery-inspired look with the Aura Ficus. Featuring a slender, natural-look trunk and a sophisticated canopy of delicate green leaves, this tree adds vertical elegance to any room. Its light, airy silhouette is perfect for minimalist spaces that need a touch of life without the clutter.

name: Veda Rustic Ficus Elastica
description: A soft, organic take on a modern classic. The Veda Rubber Tree features a slender, multi-branching stem that gives it a more natural, "wild-grown" look compared to traditional upright varieties. Its glossy, deep-green leaves are perfect for adding warmth and texture to terracotta-toned rooms or cozy reading nooks.
